sar.narrative: Customer C07297, holder of card C07297-K1, is the subject of this report due to suspicious online activity occurring between 2016-11-21 20:00 and 2016-11-21 20:30. During this 30-minute window, four online purchases totaling $1,906.07 were executed on the card using device profile 'Trident/7.0 | Windows 7 | ie 11.0 for desktop | 1920x1080'. The individual transactions included $478.95 on 2016-11-21 20:00 (reference 3476602), $456.96 on 2016-11-21 20:10 (reference 3476633), $488.04 on 2016-11-21 20:24 (reference 3476665), and $482.12 on 2016-11-21 20:30 (reference 3476682). Every amount was kept just under a $500 authorization threshold, and product code C was never used on this card before. Furthermore, the $482.12 transaction significantly exceeded the card's 95th percentile of $319.86 against a median of $60.73. The cardholder subsequently contacted the bank regarding reference 3476682, stating, "I never made this $482.12 purchase. Please check my card." This activity closely resembles eight confirmed fraud cases, including CC-0031, CC-2079, CC-3235, and CC-3423, where 8 of the 8 most similar closed cases were confirmed fraud. In response to these findings, the bank automatically created a case and escalated the matter to an analyst, while recommending the execution of BLOCK_CARD and the filing of this report.

stop_reason: Fraud probability 0.98 is at or above 0.85 with 3 independent pieces of evidence, so the decision is defensible without asking the customer (policy 6).
